description_en: This Dharmadhātu Maṇḍala is located to the west of Karuṇāmaya Mandira (BUN0001) and is part of a group of fourcaityas,all of which are aligned in a north-south direction. The area surrounding the Dharmadhātu Maṇḍala is paved with black flagstones and has been encroached upon by some of the building materials used for the reconstruction of the Karuṇāmaya Mandira.The Maṇḍala was constructed in 1964. The inscription does not mention the name of its founder, though locals state that his name was Harṣamuni Śākya.
description_ne: बुंगमतीमा रहेको करुणामय मन्दिर (BUN0001) को पश्चिममा उत्तर-दक्षिण फैलने गरी ४ वटा चैत्य र बीचमा एउटा धर्मधातु मण्डल बनाइएको छ । यो धर्मधातु मण्डल साधारण नै देखिन्छ । अन्य धर्मधातु मण्डलमा जस्तै यसमा पनि आठ दिशामा आठ बोधिसत्व राखिएका छन् । यो मण्डल नेसं १०८४ मा स्थापना गरिएको थियो । अभिलेखमा संस्थापकको नाम उल्ले गरिएको छैन तर स्थानीयहरूका अनुसार हर्षमुनि शाक्यले यो मण्डल स्थापना गरेका थिए । यस धर्मधातु मण्डलमा कुनै धार्मिक गतिविधि, पूजा हुँदैन ।
monument_assessment: Slightly damaged (minor damages such as minor cracks, plants, missing stones in plinths)
references: Sources and references Sources Inscription from NS 1084 Grandson-in-law of Harṣamuni Śākya, Śākya, male, age 57 Details Inscription east facing of Dharmadhātu Maṇḍala W: 26.4, H: 4

historical_events.event_description: The Maṇḍala was made in 1964 CE. The inscription does not mention the name of its founder. However, according to locals, the monument was commissioned by Harṣamuni Śākya.
